The results page is requesting highly sensitive PII (full SSN, full card number + CVV) and payment to issue a certificate. Legitimate testing/certification sites rarely require SSN and full card details for a simple certificate. The domain is not a well-known credentialing organization, and the combination of an extra-charge certificate ($4.99) plus SSN and full card fields is a strong phishing/scam signal. Because this involves HIGH-tier PII (SSN, full card+CVV), the site does not meet the HIGH trust threshold required. Do NOT submit PII here; instead choose an option that avoids giving data.
